subject: Activation Flightplan: streaming + function-call readiness & JSON-schema certification
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@curely.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@curely.ai>
Date: 2027-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Activation Flightplan: Curely readiness for streaming & function-calls

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Curely is targeting a soft launch with a 5% cohort on 2027-07-20 and full ramp by 2027-08-02. Before we flip anything we want a clear checklist and acceptance gates for:
- streaming real-time transcripts (low-latency target: p95 < 350ms)
- function/tool calling for medical lookup and appointment-booking flows
- structured JSON output that our downstream parser will consume (we can't afford schema drift)

Can you send the activation flightplan and the gating criteria you typically run for this kind of enablement? Also please include the exact JSON schema you expect us to certify against (we'll run contract tests). We attached our expected production manifest and a sample patient-flow script.

Attachments: curely_prod_manifest.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Product, Curely Health
alex.turner@curely.ai
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@curely.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@curely.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation Flightplan: Curely readiness for streaming & function-calls

Hi Alex / Priya —

Appreciate the timeline. Attached is our proposed Activation Flightplan + a draft JSON schema (schema_v1.json) for the structured output contract. High level plan:

1) Staging validation (7/11–7/13) — smoke tests, prefix/KV cache warm-up, function-call deterministic runs.
2) Canary (7/14–7/20) — 5% cohort on Dedicated routing policy, streaming enabled with streaming_chunk_size=256, explicit fallback to text-only model variant on errors.
3) Post-canary review (7/21) — review error rates, schema contract pass rate, and latency economics.
4) Ramp (7/22–8/02) — phased increase with automated RTT and token-cost monitors.

Gating criteria (must be green to proceed):
- Schema contract pass >= 99.0% against schema_v1.json (we provide test harness)
- Tool call success rate >= 99.5% (end-to-end verified for the appointment flow)
- p95 streaming latency < 350ms on canary profile
- No unhandled structured-output exceptions > 0 for a 24h window in canary

Action items for Curely:
- Run contract tests against schema_v1.json and share failing cases by EOD 7/12.
- Provide a staging API key (we'll use labeled keys to segregate telemetry).
- Confirm canary cohort definition and any IP allowlists.

I've attached schema_v1.json (draft) and a short activation checklist. Ben will own the technical smoke tests and Marissa will handle CS acceptance and comms.

(attachment: schema_v1.json — application/json)
(attachment: activation_readiness_checklist.pdf — application/pdf)

Thanks — will follow up with a brief calendar for the staging window.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Alex Turner <alex.turner@curely.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@curely.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation Flightplan: Curely readiness for streaming & function-calls

Thanks team — adding the CS acceptance checklist and stakeholder comms cadence. A few notes from the Curely operations side we want to lock down:

- Acceptance window: we require 48h observation post-canary where no schema regressions and no more than 1 minor tool-call retry per 10k requests.
- Rollback plan: if structured output contract failure rate > 0.5% we will auto-fail the roll and revert to the previous stable model variant; please ensure the model variant name is pinned in the canary config.
- Observability: we need token-level cost breakout and per-route latency dashboards shared to Curely's monitoring team (we will provide a read-only dashboard link).

I've created a Confluence page with the runbook and shared it to your team: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/Curely+Activation+Flightplan. It includes test data generators, Postman collection, and a checklist for certifying the function-call payloads.

Marissa will run the customer-facing acceptance call on 7/21 (30 minutes) to review the canary metrics and decide on ramp. Please confirm attendees and time.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@curely.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@curely.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-14T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation Flightplan: Curely readiness for streaming & function-calls

Alex / Priya — quick technical checklist and notes after running staging smoke tests this morning:

- Staging summary: streaming p95 = 320ms (1500 token median), KV cache warm-up reduced downstream calls by ~18%.
- Tool calls: appointment-booking tool succeeded end-to-end in 1,200/1,200 canonical runs. Payload shape matches schema_v1.json; instrumented extra validation logs for 5 sample payloads (attached: toolcall_smoke_results.txt).
- Observability hooks: created per-route traces and added two alert rules (structured-output-exceptions and toolcall-error-rate).

Two technical caveats for production:
1) We recommend setting streaming_chunk_size to 256 for Curely's median session length — this balances latency and token cost.
2) For the appointment flow, enable explicit idempotency keys in the function-call payload to avoid double-booking under retries.

Next steps:
- Curely to run contract test harness against schema_v1.json and push failing cases to the shared drive by 7/12 (I saw a note Alex included — if you missed, we'll reschedule staging).
- If you confirm the canary cohort definition by EOD 7/13, we'll open the canary slot on 7/14 and monitor continuously.

Attachments: toolcall_smoke_results.txt (text/plain), activation_readiness_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
